paragraphs: Mentioned in [Yevamot 63b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.63b.7): Rav Chisda taught in the name of Mar Ukva bar Chiya.[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Bavli, Rav Chisda transmits the interpretation of Lamentations 1:14 in Mar Ukva bar Chiya’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2861&lang=en) preserves the same direction of the chain.
